Cauley-Stein (SAC) absorbs the contact from George (OKC) and does not affect his driving shot attempt.

Temple (SAC) makes incidental contact with George (OKC) that does not affect his FOM.
Fox (SAC) legally contests Westbrook's (OKC) driving shot attempt.
Bogdanovic (SAC) maintains legal guarding position and absorbs the contact from George (OKC) on his driving shot attempt.
Anthony (OKC) reaches in and makes contact to Bogdanovic's (SAC) right arm, affecting his ability to maintain control of the ball.
